messages:
arjun: FYI planning a small config-only push tonight (midnight UTC) to tighten routing weights for APAC and reduce tinybatch variance for low-latency tenants. No model change.
deploy-bot: /schedule config-roll 1733337000 00:00 UTC canary=2% APAC -> 10% -> 100% config=cfg_apac_affinity_v1
lisa: quick summary of diffs? timeout tweaks or batching?
sophia: batching: dynamic tinybatch min 20ms (was 35ms), batch jitter reduced, routing: increase local weight + prefer-zone affinity, concurrency floor for paid tenants -> 4. Also reduce cold-ttl from 110s -> 80s.
ops-jen: Are we going to pin any routes to avoid cross-region fallthrough during canary?
arjun: We'll pin routing-policy for the canary slice only (route_pin=true). That way we can unpin the slice if we need immediate revert. No model pins.
paul: I'll run canary probes from APAC colos and watch p99. If we see increased kv-miss I'm ready to revert.
lisa: Add a fallback safety: if local latency > 200ms for >1% of requests over 5m, trigger automatic unpin (manual operator can also `/deploybot revert-config cfg_apac_affinity_v1`).
sophia: I'll add `fallback_unpin_threshold_ms:200` and a short eval set for common APAC prompts. snippet: ```json
{
  "tinybatch_min_ms": 20,
  "routing_affinity": "zone_prefer",
  "concurrency_floor": 4,
  "cold_ttl_s": 80,
  "fallback_unpin_threshold_ms": 200
}
```
ops-jen: Logging + alerts please: per-tenant p95, kv miss rate, gpu mem pressure. Create an alert: p95 up 15% OR kv_miss_rate +4% => page `#oncall-eng` and post in thread.
paul: I'll own the post-deploy check and post a quick status 5m/15m/30m. If p95 regresses >15% within 5m, we revert immediately.
arjun: Rollout plan in short: PR merged, config-id cfg_apac_affinity_v1, scheduled 00:00 UTC, canary 2% APAC, watch 15m -> 10% -> full. Rollback commands in thread. Postmortem owner: lisa if we have an incident.
lisa: I'll monitor infra and tracers. Make sure `trace-per-route` is enabled for canary slices.
sophia: No infra changes required. I'll push the config and tag the release notes. deploy-bot: release notes -> https://intranet/release-notes/1733337000. Revert shorthand: `/deploybot revert-config cfg_apac_affinity_v1` or manual: `PATCH /v1/configs/region?region=apac&cfg=previous`.
arjun: Also ensure deploy-bot annotates the change window in the calendar and adds a short blurb in the release notes about safety knobs.
paul: Will run synthetic user journeys and a stress probe for kv cache to see if miss-rate spikes.
ops-jen: I'll be ready to run revert and will escalate to platform oncall if GPU pressure shows OOM signs.
lisa: Small note: keep an eye on token cost delta during canary. If token-cost increases >3% vs baseline, we evaluate rolling back.
arjun: Good catch. Criterion list: p95 latency delta >=15% OR kv_miss +4% OR token_cost +3% => revert. Call rollback within first 10 minutes preferred.
sophia: Pushing config now to staging. Will tag `cfg_apac_affinity_v1` once validated.
arjun: Thanks everyone. We'll proceed with the midnight window. If anything odd, revert fast. :rotating_light:
